name: markvault
description: Search your MarkVault X bookmark archive and write charts to its Overview page.

interface.shortDescription: Search your saved X bookmarks and create Overview charts.
interface.longDescription: MarkVault keeps your X bookmarks in a local archive. This plugin lets the model search that archive, count bookmarks by theme or period, open a saved post, and write charts back to MarkVault's Overview page. Nothing leaves your computer; a 14-day trial or paid licence includes MCP access.
